xBRZ 1.8 by Zenju (GNU GPL v3 with the MAME exception, see the file headers and COPYING), the files
xbrz.cpp / xbrz.h / config.h as vendored by PPSSPP (ext/xbrz). Used unmodified by the FILTER < XBRZ >
option of the presenter (render_v2.cpp): the frame after the palette, ARGB, scaled 2-6x in row slices
on several threads. Consequence for the tree: a binary built with it is distributed under GPL-3
(compatible with the GPL-2.0-or-later and LGPL parts).
